notes: Tailwind v4 uses @import 'tailwindcss' and @theme block in CSS — no tailwind.config.ts needed.
Colors are defined as --color-* CSS variables inside @theme.
PostCSS config uses @tailwindcss/postcss plugin (Next.js) or @tailwindcss/vite plugin (Vite).
CSS variables in @theme enable light/dark mode switching.
These color tokens are shadcn/ui compatible — use with capability:shadcn for full component system.
Add @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { *, *::before, *::after { animation-duration: 0.01ms !important; transition-duration: 0.01ms !important; } } to globals.css for accessibility.
